correctness.rationale: For every input word, the minimum Hamming distance to the target type class is exactly one half of the l1 count discrepancy. Any coupling has at least the expected distance-to-support cost. A coordinate-permutation-equivariant minimal repair kernel attains that cost and pushes the exchangeable product law to the unique exchangeable law on the target type class, namely the uniform law. Cauchy--Schwarz gives the finite log-free bound, and the multinomial CLT plus uniform integrability gives the asymptotic constant. The recent GQSL paper explicitly supplies the single-system classical-to-quantum W1 data processing used for the quantum corollary. Orthogonal prepared states reduce quantum W1 back to classical Hamming W1. The packaged LP checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The type-class estimate is a named technical input in two recent quantum-information papers and is used directly in the arbitrarily-varying-null construction. Replacing its sqrt(log n/n) rate by an exact finite identity and log-free O(n^-1/2) bound is a structural improvement, not a cosmetic constant change. The exact asymptotic coefficient and orthogonal-state equality show the remaining n^-1/2 order is intrinsic. The result is self-contained, reusable for fixed-composition quantum mixtures, and quantitatively strengthens a current almost-i.i.d. tool while explicitly limiting its consequence to the rate of approximation rather than claiming a new Stein exponent.
